task_text: 核查以下声明（它是给定视频流传时的标题），检查视频并搜索外部证据。依据实际证据回答，说明结论范围与不确定性：Amendment to give VETERANS same healthcare as ILLEGALS fails. Are you kidding me? We are so out of wack.（发布日期：2019-09-26）
task_text_en: Fact-check the following claim, which circulated as the title of the given video, examining the video and searching for external evidence. Answer based on the evidence actually obtained, and state the scope of the conclusion and its uncertainties: Amendment to give VETERANS same healthcare as ILLEGALS fails. Are you kidding me? We are so out of wack. (posted: 2019-09-26)
claims: Amendment to give VETERANS same healthcare as ILLEGALS fails. Are you kidding me? We are so out of wack.
